leadText: Pokémon Adventures: The Seafoam Encounter is the 27th monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters 23, 24, and 25 of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

Pokémon Adventures: The Seafoam Encounter is the 27th monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters 23, 24, and 25 of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
